method: Complete original polygon-part bbox applicability; retain entire matching source feature as non-overridable territorial negative
limits: These are competing retained source claims, not current legal boundaries or a sovereignty judgment.
All original repair cells remain in the diagnostic denominator, including every competing-source contact.
Territorial applicability exceptions are absent. Foreign negatives grant no ownership and cannot override physical negatives.
Every omitted original is whole-feature bbox-disjoint from the complete original target source; no selected-cell, area threshold or metadata label excludes it.
